145 def verify_token(token: str, token_type: str = "access") -> dict[str, Any] | None:
146     """
147     Verify token signature, expiration, and type
148 
149     This function provides comprehensive token validation including:
150     - Signature verification using HS256 algorithm
151     - Expiration time checking
152     - Token type validation to prevent token confusion attacks
153 
154     Token type validation ensures that access tokens cannot be used as refresh
155     tokens and vice versa, preventing token confusion attacks where an attacker
156     might try to use a short-lived access token in place of a long-lived refresh
157     token or vice versa.
158 
159     Args:
160         token: JWT token string to verify
161         token_type: Expected token type ("access" or "refresh")
162 
163     Returns:
164         Decoded payload if valid and type matches, None otherwise
165 
166     Security Notes:
167         - Returns None for any validation failure (signature, expiration, or type)
168         - Token type mismatch is treated as a security violation
169         - All tokens must include a "type" field in their payload
170     """
171     payload = decode_token(token)
172 
173     if payload is None:
174         return None
175 
176     # Validate token type matches expected type
177     # This prevents token confusion attacks
178     if payload.get("type") != token_type:
179         return None
180 
181     return payload
